name: Shadow
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 185.
Medium Undead. Dexterity increases by 1. Walk 35 ft. and see in darkness out to 60 ft. Understand, read and write Common. Cannot speak or supply verbal spell components.
Amorphous lets the Shadow pass through gaps at least 1 inch wide without squeezing. Shadow Stealth allows a bonus-action Hide in dim light or darkness.
Immune to poison damage and the exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned and restrained conditions. In sunlight, attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws have disadvantage.
The Shadow needs no air, food, drink or sleep. Four hours of semiconscious rest replace eight hours of sleep.

Strength Drain changes unarmed strike damage to 1d8 necrotic. When an unarmed attack rolls a natural 20 against a living creature, it also forces a Strength save. The DC is 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier.

On the first failed save, Strength attacks, checks and saves have disadvantage until the target finishes a short or long rest or receives lesser restoration or comparable magic. On another natural 20 while the drain lasts, a second failed save drops the target to 0 HP and it begins dying. A successful second save leaves the first drain in place.

name: Blood Hawk
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 224.
Small Beast. Dexterity and Wisdom each increase by 1. Walk 10 ft. and fly 50 ft. Flight is unavailable in medium or heavy armor. Speak, read and write Common.
Keen Sight gives advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
The bite is an unarmed strike that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Dexterity can replace Strength for attack and damage. For rules that require finesse, the bite counts as a finesse weapon.
Pack Tactics uses a bonus action. The next attack this turn has advantage if its target is within 5 ft. of an ally who is not incapacitated.
No Hands prevents using weapons, shields and items that require manipulation, including tools and spellcasting foci.

name: Flying Snake
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 231.
Small Beast. Dexterity increases by 2. Walk, swim and fly at 30 ft. Blindsight 10 ft. Speak, read and write Common.
Bite deals 1d4 piercing and 1d4 poison as an unarmed strike. Dexterity can replace Strength for attack and damage. The bite counts as a finesse weapon for rules that require finesse.
Serpentine Body prevents using armor, shields and weapons. Lacking arms or hands also bars items that need manipulation, including tools, wands and spellcasting foci.
The flight clause bars medium or heavy armor. Serpentine Body already rules out wearing any armor.

name: Giant Centipede
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 234.
Small Beast. Dexterity increases by 1. Walk and climb at 30 ft. Blindsight 60 ft. Speak, read and write Common.
The bite is an unarmed strike for 1d4 piercing plus 1d4 poison. Dexterity can replace Strength for attack and damage. The bite counts as a finesse weapon for rules that require finesse.
Natural Armor gives AC 11 + Dexterity modifier when unarmored.
No Hands prevents wielding weapons or shields and using objects that require manipulation, including tools, wands and spellcasting foci.
